result:
The hint under each **Export plan** button now gives your two steps and the removal line, and the exported file carries the plan's name as its calendar name. I tested on copies, including a copy of your real data, and checked the page in a real browser. The general, week view and export test suites pass, your real database's fingerprint stayed the same, and nothing is committed.

The hint now reads:

1. In Google Calendar, go to Settings, Add calendar, Create new calendar, and name it after the plan.
2. Go to Settings, Import & export, choose the exported file, and pick that new calendar under "Add to calendar".

To remove the plan later, delete that calendar.

**Calendar name:** plans don't have a separate name field, so I used the title shown on the Plans page, such as "5K on Sun, Jan 10, 2027". The file previously said "5K training plan", which would be the same for two 5K plans.

**The name may not show up in Google Calendar:** as far as I know, Google ignores a file's calendar name on import and uses the calendar you pick, which is why step 1 still matters. Other calendar apps may use it. I haven't tried this in Google Calendar itself, so please run through the steps once with a real plan.

Restart the app to see this. The login and signup pages are unchanged.
